KnowledgeBaseVO.description_en: The knowledge and its associated asset information
KnowledgeBaseVO.description_zh: 知识及其关联资产信息

Category.description_en: The category to which the knowledge belongs. For example, OBJECT indicates object knowledge
Category.description_zh: 知识所属大类，例如 OBJECT 表示对象知识

Confidence.description_en: The confidence score of the knowledge

DbId.description_en: The ID of the database in DMS

Description.description_en: The detailed business description of the knowledge
Description.example: 保存订单及其关联业务信息。

EntityId.description_en: The ID of the entity corresponding to the knowledge. The meaning of the entity is determined by KnowledgeType
EntityId.description_zh: 知识对应的实体 ID。实体含义由 KnowledgeType 决定

Env.description_en: The name of the environment to which the instance belongs

Expr.description_en: The expression corresponding to the knowledge. For table knowledge, it is the table name. For column knowledge, it is a combination of the table name and the column name. For SQL knowledge, it is the corresponding SQL expression
Expr.description_zh: 知识对应的表达式。表知识为表名，字段知识为表名与字段名的组合，SQL 知识为对应 SQL 表达式

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the asset corresponding to the knowledge. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
GmtCreate.description_zh: 知识对应资产的创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

IsDelete.description_en:
Specifies whether the knowledge is marked as deleted. Valid values:
true: Deleted.
false: Not deleted
IsDelete.description_zh: 知识是否已标记删除。true 表示已删除，false 表示未删除

KnowledgeId.description_en: The knowledge identifier, which is generated by combining the knowledge display type with the corresponding entity identifier or expression
KnowledgeId.description_zh: 知识标识，由知识展示类型与对应的实体标识或表达式组合生成

KnowledgeType.description_en: The knowledge type. For example, TABLE indicates table knowledge, COLUMN indicates column knowledge, and DMS_SQL indicates SQL knowledge
KnowledgeType.description_zh: 知识类型，例如 TABLE 表示表知识，COLUMN 表示字段知识，DMS_SQL 表示 SQL 知识

LevelType.description_en:
The status of the knowledge. Valid values:
to_completed: To be completed.
to_verify: To be verified.
verified: Verified.
verify_failed: Verification failed.
is_delete: Deleted.
unlocked: Unlocked.
locked: Locked
LevelType.description_zh: 知识状态。to_completed：待补充；to_verify：待认证；verified：已认证；verify_failed：认证失败；is_delete：已删除；unlocked：未锁定；locked：已锁定

Name.description_en: The name of the asset corresponding to the knowledge

OldDescription.description_en: The knowledge description before the change

OldSummary.description_en: The knowledge summary before the change, which is used to compare with the current summary
OldSummary.description_zh: 变更前的知识摘要，用于与当前摘要比较

ParseDesc.description_en: The parsing result of the knowledge, which is stored as a JSON string
ParseDesc.description_zh: 知识解析结果，以字符串形式保存的 JSON 内容

ReasoningLogic.description_en: The reasoning description for the knowledge generation or identification process
ReasoningLogic.description_zh: 知识生成或识别过程的推理说明
ReasoningLogic.example: 根据表结构和字段注释识别订单业务。

RelationType.description_en: The association type between knowledge items

ShowType.description_en: The display type of the knowledge, such as TABLE, COLUMN, SQL, and SEG
ShowType.description_zh: 知识的展示类型，例如 TABLE、COLUMN、SQL、SEG

description_en: Queries a paginated list of asset knowledge related to a specific table. This knowledge includes information about tables, columns, SQL statements, and snippets
description_zh: 分页查询某张表相关的资产知识列表（含表/字段/SQL/片段等）
name: SearchTableAssetKnowledge

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html API to obtain this ID
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search on knowledge content
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，用于模糊匹配知识内容
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The type of knowledge to return. Valid values: `TABLE`, `COLUMN`, `SQL`, and `SEG`. If this parameter is omitted, all types are returned
parameters.help_zh: 知识展示类型筛选，可选值如 TABLE、COLUMN、SQL、SEG 等，为空表示全部
parameters.name: show_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. The default value is 20
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The pagination offset. The default value is 0
parameters.name: offset

Items.description_en: A list of asset knowledge items

items.description_en: An object that contains the details of an asset knowledge item
items.description_zh:
表名，您可以调用[ListTables]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html）接口获取该参数。

该参数必填的情况：ResourceType的参数值为META_TABLE或LOGIC_TABLE

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request succeeded. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
Success.title_en:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
Success.title_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
